rationale: B is more useful because it gives a clearer basis for choosing the hybrid strategy over alternatives: it claims dominance/ties on KPIs, compares against the next-best option, and discusses confidence intervals and downside risk. Its quantitative framing is imperfect but materially more decision-relevant than A’s mostly fragmentary KPI/table snippets. A recommends the same option but provides little discriminative reasoning, weak caveat handling, and almost no usable quantitative support. Neither clearly states revisit triggers or the main alternative, but B still better supports a careful human deciding among live launch strategies.
